---
title: "[R code tutor 查核清單]{.zh}[R Code Tutor Verification Checklist]{.en}"
---

::: {.zh}
本頁對應 `PROPOSAL.zh-TW.md` §5.3 的第二份查核清單：涵蓋 `verify/workflow.qmd`
流程裡的 P0–P1、V2–V4、V5、C1–C2 步驟，設計成可列印的一頁。適用對象是使用
**R code tutor**（`askllmr`）取得 R 程式碼的情境；若你用的是 Module
Guider（`askllm`），請改用 `checklist-guider.qmd`。
:::

::: {.en}
This page is the second of the two verification checklists described in
`PROPOSAL.zh-TW.md` §5.3. It covers steps P0–P1, V2–V4, V5, and C1–C2 of the
workflow in `verify/workflow.qmd`, laid out as a single printable page. Use it
when you asked the **R code tutor** (`askllmr`) for R code. If you used the
Module Guider (`askllm`) instead, use `checklist-guider.qmd`.
:::

::: {.zh}
與 `checklist-guider.qmd` 最大的差異在於：R code tutor 的答案空間不是有限
集合（不像選單路徑可以逐條核對），R 是 Turing-complete，沒有任何掃描能證明
一段任意生成的程式碼「如它所說地運作」。所以這裡沒有 V1 路徑核對，取而代之
的是 **V4 程式碼核對**，拆成讀（4a）、跑（4b）、對（4c）三段——這是流程性
的查核，不是機械性的查核。詳見 `askLLM/docs/LIMITATIONS.zh-TW.md`〈兩個分析，
兩種查證方式〉一節。
:::

::: {.en}
The key difference from `checklist-guider.qmd` is that the R code tutor's
output space is not a finite, checkable set the way menu paths are — R is
Turing-complete, so no scan can prove that an arbitrary piece of generated
code actually "works as claimed." So there is no V1 path check here; instead
there is **V4, the code check**, split into read (4a), run (4b), and cross-check
(4c). This is a procedural check, not a mechanical one. See the "Two
analyses, two ways to verify" section of `askLLM/docs/LIMITATIONS.zh-TW.md`
for background.
:::

## [送出前]{.zh}[Before you submit]{.en}

::: {.zh}
- [ ] **P0** 我已經寫下「我會接受什麼答案」（例如：程式碼必須只用
      `data` 這個物件名稱、必須產出我要的統計量、不得需要我自己補檔案路徑）。
- [ ] **P1** 我已經記下摘要裡的關鍵數字（每一組的 n、mean、sd、遺漏數），
      這些數字之後要拿來跟程式碼的輸出核對。
:::

::: {.en}
- [ ] **P0** I have written down what answer I will accept (e.g. "the code
      must use only the object name `data`, must produce the statistic I
      asked for, and must not require me to fill in a file path myself").
- [ ] **P1** I have written down the key numbers from the summary (n, mean, sd,
      missing count per group) so I can check the code's output against them
      later.
:::

## [收到回覆後]{.zh}[After you receive a reply]{.en}

::: {.zh}
- [ ] **V2 數字核對** — 執行後的輸出數字（n、mean、sd 等），跟我在 P1
      記下的、以及在 Descriptives 面板看到的一致。
- [ ] **V3 範圍核對** — 回覆有沒有宣稱它「看不到」的東西（例如常態性、離
      群值、原始資料列的內容）？如果有，這是「越界」，代表回覆超出摘要統計
      能支持的範圍，應打折扣看待。
- [ ] **V4a 讀** — 逐行讀完整段程式碼，確認：
      - 資料只用 `data` 這個物件名稱，沒有另外指定其他資料來源；
      - 每一個 `library(...)` 引用的套件，都出現在 askLLM 附給模型的
        `<rj_environment>` 套件清單內，或屬於 base R；
      - 沒有出現「紅旗指令」（見下方紅旗字串表）。
      **只要有一項沒通過，就先不要執行**，回頭修改問題或換一個 persona
      再問一次。
- [ ] **V4b 跑** — 把程式碼**原封不動**貼進 Rj Editor（`Analyses ▸ R ▸
      Rj ▸ Rj Editor`），按下 Run，把輸出或錯誤訊息原文記下來（成功的輸出
      與失敗的錯誤訊息都要記，不要只記成功的）。
- [ ] **V4c 對** — 用另一個獨立管道重跑同一個分析，比較關鍵數字是否一致：
      改用 jamovi GUI 對應的分析模組跑一次；或在該分析的 Syntax Mode 中查看
      jamovi 自己產生的 `jmv::` 呼叫，作為第二層獨立對照。
- [ ] **V5 交叉核對** — 換一個 persona（Consultant / Tutor / Explainer）
      或換一個模型，針對同一個 `What should the R code do?` 問題再問一次；
      兩次程式碼的邏輯與輸出是否一致？（V4a／V4b 仍須對第二份程式碼各自
      重跑一次，不能因為兩次都「看起來合理」就省略讀碼與執行。）
:::

::: {.en}
- [ ] **V2 Number check** — The numbers produced by running the code (n, mean,
      sd, etc.) match what I wrote down in P1 and what I see in the
      Descriptives panel.
- [ ] **V3 Scope check** — Does the reply make claims about things it cannot
      actually see (e.g. normality, outliers, the content of raw data rows)?
      If so, flag this as "overreaching" — the claim exceeds what summary
      statistics can support, and should be discounted.
- [ ] **V4a Read** — Read the entire code block line by line and confirm:
      - the data is referenced only through the object name `data`, with no
        other data source specified;
      - every `library(...)` call names a package that appears in the
        `<rj_environment>` package list askLLM sent the model, or is base R;
      - none of the red-flag instructions below appear.
      **If any of these fails, do not run the code.** Rephrase the question
      or try a different persona instead.
- [ ] **V4b Run** — Paste the code **verbatim, unmodified** into the Rj Editor
      (`Analyses ▸ R ▸ Rj ▸ Rj Editor`), press Run, and record the exact
      output or error message (record both a successful output and a failed
      error message — don't only keep the successes).
- [ ] **V4c Cross-check** — Re-run the same analysis through an independent
      channel and compare the key numbers: run the equivalent analysis
      through the jamovi GUI; or check that analysis's Syntax Mode for the
      `jmv::` call jamovi generates itself, as a second, independent
      comparison.
- [ ] **V5 Cross-check (persona/model)** — Ask the same "What should the R
      code do?" question again with a different persona (Consultant / Tutor /
      Explainer) or a different model. Do the two pieces of code agree in
      logic and output? (Still repeat V4a/V4b on the second piece of code —
      two replies "looking reasonable" is not a substitute for reading and
      running each one.)
:::

## [結案]{.zh}[Closing out]{.en}

::: {.zh}
- [ ] **C1** 對照 P0 寫下的判準：solved（全部命中，程式碼可用）還是 reopen
      （任一項沒通過，需要換個問法或換個 persona 再試）。
- [ ] **C2** 填寫協作日誌四欄：問題 / 判準 / 回覆摘要 / 查核結果。
:::

::: {.en}
- [ ] **C1** Compare the reply against the P0 criteria: solved (everything
      checks out — the code is usable) or reopen (something failed —
      rephrase the question or try a different persona).
- [ ] **C2** Fill in the four-column collaboration log: question / criteria /
      reply summary / verification result.
:::

## [紅旗字串表（4a 逐行核對用）]{.zh}[Red-flag string table (for V4a)]{.en}

::: {.zh}
askLLM 的 system prompt 明文禁止模型在 R code tutor 的回覆裡使用下列指令
（見 `askLLM/R/llm-adapter.R` 第 172–177 行）。若程式碼裡出現任何一項，代表
回覆違反了 askLLM 自己設定的邊界，應標記為「不可執行」並回頭修改問題：
:::

::: {.en}
askLLM's system prompt explicitly forbids the model from using the following
in an R code tutor reply (see `askLLM/R/llm-adapter.R`, lines 172–177). If any
of these appear in the code, the reply has violated askLLM's own stated
boundary — flag it as "do not run" and go back and rephrase the question:
:::

| [紅旗]{.zh}[Red flag]{.en} | [為什麼]{.zh}[Why]{.en} |
|---|---|
| `install.packages(...)` | [模型不能替你安裝套件；Rj 只用已裝好的套件。]{.zh}[The model cannot install packages for you; Rj only has what is already installed.]{.en} |
| `read.csv(...)`／[任何檔案讀取函式]{.zh}[/ any file-reading function]{.en} | [不得建議讀取檔案；資料一律用 `data` 這個既有物件。]{.zh}[No file reads are allowed; the data must always come from the existing `data` object.]{.en} |
| `setwd(...)` | [不得變更工作目錄。]{.zh}[The working directory must not be changed.]{.en} |
| [任何絕對路徑（如 `C:/...`、`/Users/...`）]{.zh}[Any absolute file path (e.g. `C:/...`, `/Users/...`)]{.en} | [路徑因人而異，不可能通用，且暗示前一條「檔案讀取」紅旗。]{.zh}[Paths are machine-specific and can't generalize; this usually co-occurs with the file-read red flag above.]{.en} |
| `system(...)` | [不得呼叫系統層級指令。]{.zh}[System-level shell calls are not allowed.]{.en} |
| `library(套件)`，但該套件**不在** `<rj_environment>` 清單內、也非 base R | [模型只能引用你 Rj 裡實際裝了的套件；引用未裝套件的程式碼一執行就會出現 `there is no package called '...'`。]{.zh}[`library(package)` where the package is **not** in the `<rj_environment>` list and is not base R — the model may only cite packages actually installed in your Rj; code citing an uninstalled package will fail immediately with `there is no package called '...'`.]{.en} |

::: {.zh}
> 提醒：`<rj_environment>` 這個套件清單只有在你的 jamovi 裝有 Rj、且
> askLLM 掃描到套件時才會附上。若你的 jamovi 沒裝 Rj，askLLM 會改教你
> 用 Syntax Mode，而不是硬生出一段你根本跑不了的程式碼；這種情況下本清單
> 的 4a／4b 步驟不適用，因為根本沒有 Rj Editor 可以貼上執行。
:::

::: {.en}
> Note: the `<rj_environment>` package list is only attached when your
> jamovi has Rj installed and askLLM was able to scan its packages. If Rj is
> not installed, askLLM should instead teach you to use Syntax Mode rather
> than generating code you cannot actually run — in that case steps 4a/4b of
> this checklist do not apply, since there is no Rj Editor to paste into.
:::
